usedFor: Shopify and WooCommerce are rival stores, so this pair suits a team that runs one of each. “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify can create a coupon through “Create Coupon” in WooCommerce.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Coupon” in WooCommerce
bestTemplate.why: It reacts to a shopper who left without paying, and “Create Coupon” makes a code in your WooCommerce store. The WooCommerce order trigger only pairs with Shopify triggers, not an action.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so the coupon appears after the next check. “Create Coupon” makes a new code on every run, and it exists only in the WooCommerce store, not in Shopify.
